description:
Morbid Metal is now available on Steam. Save 25% with a special launch discount.
🔗 Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/186613

Morbid Metal is a stylish fast paced hack and slash roguelite set in a dark sci fi world. Switch characters instantly mid fight to chain abilities into devastating combos and tear through waves of lethal machines. Take risks to gain power and build momentum as you face cinematic, challenging bosses. Death is how you evolve. Break through the simulation.

🔗 Steam Page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

Developed by Screenjuice in Unity and published by Ubisoft.

description:
Want to adjust your challenge level in The Division 2? This quick guide shows you how to change in-game difficulty so you can tailor your experience to match your playstyle and earn better rewards.

In this video, we walk you through where to find the difficulty settings and how to switch between different world tiers and mission difficulties in The Division 2.
